tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Amazon released TorchNeuron to help companies move artificial intelligence workloads from Nvidia chips, cutting switching costs through PyTorch support on Trainium. Reported by Startup Fortune.
Hugging Face's policy chief says embedded artificial intelligence evaluators won't be an easy solution, as labs debate benchmark reliability and standardized evaluations. Reported by TechCrunch.
Anthropic committed 5 percent of shares to a new public benefit fund addressing artificial intelligence job disruption, with potential increases as valuation grows. Confirmed by CNBC.
Nvidia's CEO urged German manufacturers to adopt artificial intelligence for manufacturing, calling it a chance to re-engineer industry without replacing heavy industry. Confirmed by Orange County Register.
New Jersey lawmakers are weighing artificial intelligence regulations as industry and safety experts clash over policy direction. Reported by New Jersey Monitor.
Free every hour.
